summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Vinted Manager v2.0 enhancements. Dashboard KPIs, Sourcing improvements (DONNEES_INSUFFISANTES + category bonus), Stock ANALYSE badge, profit calc, and tab-bar sizing all work as expected. Found one blocking bug: Plus tab Import CSV button is missing from the UI despite handler being implemented.

ui_bugs.issue: Import CSV button is missing in the UI. The `onImportCsv` handler is declared (line ~130) but no TouchableOpacity / Card with testID='import-csv' is rendered. 'Import CSV' section is entirely absent from the Plus screen JSX. Required testID `import-csv` cannot be found.

Fresh items (daysOnline=0, heures<2) always display 'Jours 1' instead of 'Heures Xh'. Root cause: in analytics.ts `timeSincePost`, `days = Math.max(1, rawHours/24)` floors days at 1, so the condition `time.days >= 1 ? 'Jours' : 'Heures'` in stock.tsx line 165 always resolves to 'Jours'. The 'Heures Xh' branch is unreachable. Recommend using `t.phase === 'init' || t.phase === 'heures'` or `rawHours < 24` check instead.

action_items: Add the missing 'Import CSV' section + TouchableOpacity/Card with testID='import-csv' in app/(tabs)/plus.tsx, wired to the existing `onImportCsv` handler. Place it near the Export CSV section (e.g. a new SectionTitle 'Import CSV' with a card using icon 'cloud-upload-outline' or similar).

Fix the 'Jours/Heures' label in stock.tsx so fresh articles show 'Heures Xh'. Either expose raw hours in TimeInfo or switch the condition to use `t.phase` (e.g. `t.phase === 'heures' || t.phase === 'init'`).
critical_code_review_comments: plus.tsx: `onImportCsv` is dead code in UI — handler defined but never referenced in JSX. Likely an unfinished task when adding CSV import feature.

analytics.ts `timeSincePost` uses `Math.max(1, rawHours/24)` for `days`, which correctly protects against div-by-zero but destroys the sub-day granularity used by the UI. Consider keeping `days` as raw and adding a separate `safeDays` for score math.
seed_data_creation: Transient test articles (TEST Pantalon Carhartt 13/25€ and TEST NoBuy Nike 0/20€) were created to validate profit/coût inconnu/ANALYSE badge and deleted at the end of the run. Final stock: 0 items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://vinted-stock-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env EXPO_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME — the URL mentioned in the request is stale). Dashboard all testIDs OK. Sourcing DONNEES_INSUFFISANTES, leggings (−10), workwear (+40) all verified OK. Stock ANALYSE badge appears when adding a fresh item via /stock-new with daysOnline=0. Bénéf calc correct. Tab bar height ~78px on web preview. Only bug left is: Plus tab missing Import CSV button wiring.
rca_of_issue: Plus Import CSV bug RCA — In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/plus.tsx, the developer imported `importCsvBackup`, implemented `onImportCsv` wrapper with proper error handling (lines ~130-150), but never added the corresponding `<TouchableOpacity testID="import-csv" onPress={onImportCsv}>` Card in the returned JSX tree. The Plus screen only renders: MENU items (sourcing/niches/clients/retours), Sauvegarde & Restauration (backup-create, backup-restore), Export CSV (export-stock/ventes/retours), and reset. Reproduction: open app → Plus tab → scroll → no Import CSV section visible. Mitigation: add a SectionTitle 'Import CSV' and a Card/TouchableOpacity onPress={onImportCsv} with testID='import-csv'.
